title: Blender MCP gives language models a safer path into 3D creation
friendlyTitle: Control Blender with an AI assistant
summary: Blender MCP is a roughly 27,200-star community integration that lets MCP-compatible assistants inspect scenes, create and modify 3D objects and run Blender operations from natural-language requests. Recent updates added a safe mode for bounded code execution, tests and a Dockerfile.
friendlySummary: This popular community project connects AI assistants to Blender so they can inspect a scene and help create or change 3D objects. Recent updates added safer code limits and tests.
whyItMatters: Artists and developers can use it to prototype scenes, automate repetitive Blender work and let an assistant operate against visible scene state. Because it can execute powerful actions inside a creative tool, start with safe mode, review generated changes and keep versioned project files.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it for quick scene drafts and repeated Blender tasks. Turn on the safer mode, check every important change and keep backup versions of your project.
